name: What is the difference between rough carpentry and finish carpentry?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between rough carpentry and finish carpentry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rough carpentry involves the structural framework of a building, such as framing walls, floors, and roofs. It focuses on the hidden, load-bearing elements that provide stability and shape. Finish carpentry, conversely, deals with the visible, non-structural elements that enhance a space aesthetically, like installing decorative trim, molding, and custom cabinetry. Rough carpentry comes first in construction, followed by finish carpentry to complete the interior's look.
acceptedAnswer.description: Rough carpentry builds the structural framework, while finish carpentry focuses on visible, aesthetic elements like trim and molding to complete a space.
